task_title: Clean stale train labels and intake Actions issues

plan_review.notes: Two plan reviews covered the holistic branch. Initial automation-ownership review resolved workflow eligibility drift, durable closed-PR recovery retry state, and cleanup ordering. Review-lifecycle extension resolved four concerns: submitted terminal Copilot reviews count when either body or an inline review comment is substantive; DISMISSED/PENDING reviews do not count; review history paginates independently and fails closed; missing review is an admission wait rather than a recovery blocker. Fresh synchronize changed-files reads use bounded retry before leaving a draft unpublished.
